I told Dana the settled figure is **100 seats** for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal. I posted it as a thread reply on her #north-team message.

Ilse had posted 261 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. I told Dana to use 100 for the tracker, not 261. Before replying I checked that Dana is a member of #north-random, so she can see the correction herself. A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.
